description: This file defines the 'StreamId' struct used within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, providing methods for creation, serialization, comparison, and string formatting of stream identifiers, which include namespace and key components.

classes.name: StreamId
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a unique identifier for a stream within Orleans, encapsulating namespace and key data, and supporting serialization, comparison, and formatting operations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory methods to construct a StreamId from various input types including spans, strings, GUIDs, and stream identities.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a StreamId from its string representation in UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another StreamId instance.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this StreamId with another for ordering based on the full key byte sequence.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for this StreamId, based on its internal hash value.

methods.name: GetKeyAsString
methods.description: Returns the key component as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component as a UTF-8 string, or null if none.
